prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film. Staged like the opening titles of a 1960s spy film: the figures are almost photographic, but the space behind them dissolves into a flat flood of saturated colour, molten gold fading into deep magenta, with drifting smoke. Camera low at the height of the firebox, banknotes scattered on the stone floor in front. A huge cast-iron printing press glows red hot, spitting notes; beside it the man from the character reference shovels coal into its firebox, grinning, his eyes narrowed with glee; behind him an exhausted stoker in a soot-black vest sits slumped against the wall. One hard white spotlight from above. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
